name: Why is drunk driving particularly dangerous in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: Why is drunk driving particularly dangerous in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alcohol slows reaction time and causes poor judgment, leading to lane drifting, speeding, red-light running, and fatal crashes—San Diego’s roads and nightlife make these accidents more likely.hillstonelaw+1​
